name: @tile/build
description: The page-generation half of a site build: an IR directory in, a directory of static HTML out. Collect the IR into the site_pages shape, stage it into packages/sitetile/astro, run astro build, put the renderer back. Deployment — uploading, build stamps, redirect merging, canonical-host rewriting, API workers — is not here and is not meant to be.
//: 🩸 THERE IS NO `main` HERE, AND THAT IS A GATE, NOT AN OMISSION. With `main: index.mjs`,
`node --test packages/build/` resolves the DIRECTORY to that one file, runs it as the whole
suite, finds no tests in it and exits 0. Measured 2026-09-06: the gate reported `# tests 1 /
# pass 1` while every real test file in this package went unread. `exports` alone resolves
`import '@tile/build'` identically and leaves the directory searchable, so that is what is
here — and manifest.test.mjs fails if `main` ever comes back.
